controls.rhythm: one quarter per beat; half-beat sounding, 10 ms linear attack and release
controls.tempo: any constant positive BPM whose half-beat accommodates attack/release; boundaries rounded to nearest sample

envelope: min(1, sampleFromOnset/480, samplesUntilRelease/480); note phase resets at onset
end: last audible release + 0.5 seconds; silence control uses explicit 8.5 seconds

perturbations.descending: reverse the score walk pitches while preserving its times; scoreNoteId=null

labels: actual rendered sample boundaries; score duration is separate; positive following ends at final release; trailing silence unknown
